messages:
hope_security: Auditor asked for a focused proof bundle that links a single RBAC change made during a vuln triage to the git commit -> CI apply -> kube-apiserver audit log -> CloudTrail/STC events -> KMS key state and any break-glass approvals. Need plan + artifacts.
dan_oncall: Scope it to staging. Minimal artifacts: PR diff (rolebinding), CI build log with COMMIT_SHA & PIPE_ID, kube audit snippet, CloudTrail/Splunk export for STS/KMS events, KMS describe + rotation status, runbook approval log (if break-glass used).
auditor_paul: Staging replay acceptable. Provide a short MP4 of the replay, the exact extraction queries you ran, and a CSV mapping artifact -> SOC2/ISO control(s). Sanitize all IDs.
nina_platform: I can create an ephemeral service account and apply a rolebinding in staging during the window. Will capture: kubectl apply output, controller events, CI console output, and the KMS rotate/describe call if we exercise rotation. Will tear down after.
hope_security: Please paste the exact commands/queries you'll include so I can add them to the README in the evidence bundle. Also include the sanitizer steps.
nina_platform: K8s audit extraction (parametrized):
```bash
# extract audit events referencing the demo rolebinding in staging
jq -c 'select(.objectRef.resource=="rolebindings" and .objectRef.namespace=="staging-triage")' /var/log/kube-apiserver/audit.log | sed -n '1,80p'
```
CloudTrail/Splunk query (example):
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail (eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=PutRolePolicy OR eventName=RotateKey) | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters, resources
```
KMS commands to include (staging):
```bash
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/STAGING-DEMO --profile staging
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/STAGING-DEMO --profile staging
```
CI tie (we'll capture exact lines printed by the pipeline):
```bash
# example attached lines
COMMIT_SHA=ab12cd34ef56
PIPELINE_ID=ci/12890
kubectl apply -f rolebinding-staging-triage.yaml --record
```
ops-bot: Uploaded artifact: ci-12890.log (sanitized). Uploaded artifact: runbook-run-2024-11-22.log (redacted).
hope_security: Deliverables I'll assemble: rolebinding-diff.patch, ci-12890.log, kube-audit-snippet.jsonl, cloudtrail-sts-kms.csv, kms-describe.json, runbook-run-2024-11-22.log, mapping.csv (artifact -> SOC2/ISO -> one-line rationale), timeline.txt, and demo.mp4 (60	60s).
dan_oncall: Important: run infra/tools/scrub-ids.sh on all exports, then grep for UUIDs/IPs to double-check. Document the scrub steps in README: commands and substitution tokens used.
auditor_paul: Also include the PR URL (internal) and the PR merge commit SHA. If break-glass was used, include the approval email or ticket ID and who authorized it. The CSV mapping should reference SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO 27001 clauses A.9 / A.12 where applicable.
nina_platform: Will include PR-1489, merge SHA ab12cd34ef56, pipeline console output (sanitized), and timeline linking timestamps (commit -> CI -> kube audit event time -> CloudTrail time -> KMS call time). Schedule: rehearsal Fri 09:30 PT, artifacts packaged by EOD Fri.
hope_security: Sounds good. If anyone thinks we should also attach the policy docs that define who can approve rolebindings (IAM policy ARN), flag it now.
dan_oncall: Good idea to include the short policy snippet showing the permission set that allowed the CI role to call kubeapply. Keep it to one file (policy-snippet.json) and reference control mapping.
auditor_paul: That will be helpful. After package, I'll do a quick review and request any follow-ups. Thanks team.
